description: God class: UserManager has >5 responsibilities (DB connection, CRUD, authentication, HTML rendering, CSV export/import, audit logging) and should be decomposed
Missing input validation: create_user() accepts arbitrary username, email, password, and role values without any validation or sanitisation
SQL injection: multiple queries use f-string interpolation of user-supplied data instead of parameterised queries (create_user, get_user, update_user, delete_user, list_users, authenticate)
Hardcoded credentials: admin username, password, and API key are stored as module-level constants in source code
No error handling on file I/O: export_users_csv() and import_users_csv() do not handle FileNotFoundError, PermissionError, or other I/O exceptions
Race condition: increment_counter() reads and writes _user_counter without acquiring _counter_lock, so concurrent threads can lose increments
Memory leak: _audit_log is a module-level list that grows with every action and is never cleared, truncated, or rotated
XSS vulnerability: render_user_profile() and render_user_list_page() interpolate user-supplied data directly into HTML without escaping
